2) 30 min — guided prompt review with live generation examples (we'll record)

Subject: Re: POC makeup session — runbook addendum + reminders

Great — thanks for confirming Wed 2027-05-12 10:00 PT earlier. Apologies for the delay on the addendum; attached is a two-page checklist that specifically calls out the KV cache warm-up steps and the quick telemetry markers to watch (expected hit-rate ramp, prefix warm strategy, p50/p95 targets). I'll paste the key checklist below so it's easy to reference in the meeting: 

KV cache warm-up checklist (short):
- Prime order: send the 10 canonical prompts in sequence, followed by the 50 short-edge prompts to exercise caching across keys
- Expected hit-rate: aim for >70% within first 2 minutes for common prefixes; >85% by 5 minutes for full prefix set (dependent on RTT)
- Batching guidance: use the batching-config "latency-first" for the replay; switch to "throughput-stable" for the sustained burst run
- Fallbacks: if p95 > 500ms for 30s, drop to the quantized model variant and note delta in the eval sheet

I've uploaded the addendum to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=redwood-poc-runbook-v1 and resent the calendar invite (Wed 2027-05-12 10:00 PT). Looking forward to it — we'll record and extract the prompt examples for your acceptance tests.

If anything changes on your side, please ping me here.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
